content:
Use a high-density anime game character trailer-style prompt with a detailed narrative arc (infiltration → theft → city lockdown/chase → tower breakthrough → giant digital magic portal → high-altitude escape) to drive coherent multi-scene action in Seedance 2.5  
Add a character reference token (@[character ref]) to keep the main character consistent across the generated video

ko.content:

생성된 영상 전반에서 주인공의 일관성을 유지하기 위해 캐릭터 레퍼런스 토큰(@[character ref])을 추가하세요.
